data.long_meaning: Balarama is the older brother of Krishna. The name Balakrishna is a combination of Balarama (Bal) and Krishna (Krishna). Balakrishna is a name that is widely used among Hindus, especially in India. It is believed that the name Balakrishna brings prosperity, good fortune, and protection. The name Balakrishna carries the meaning “Little Krishna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balakrishna usually hope their child will grow to embody little krishna and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Balakrishna is a deity venerated by millions of Hindus around the world. He is considered an avatar of Lord Vishnu and is also known as Sankara, Subhadra-Narayana, or Balarama. Balakrishna is a popular cultural icon, often depicted as a strong and muscular man carrying a mace (gada) and a plow (ankus), symbolizing his role as a protector and provider. He is also seen as the elder brother of Lord Krishna and an embodiment of unwavering devotion and strength. Balakrishna festivals and rituals are celebrated throughout India and Nepal, with the famous Balaji Temple in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, being one of the most popular pilgrimage sites for the deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Balakrishna holds great spiritual significance in Hinduism. Balakrishna is believed to be an avatar of Lord Vishnu, and the name symbolizes the union of strength (represented by Balarama) and divine grace (represented by Krishna). Balakrishna is a reminder of the divine presence within us, and the importance of unwavering devotion and strength in the face of adversity. The name is often chanted as a mantra for protection, prosperity, and good fortune. Additionally, the name Balakrishna is also associated with the qualities of courage, discipline, and righteousness, making it a powerful name for those seeking spiritual growth and self-improvement.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balakrishna is a name symbolizing childhood and divine grace. 'Bala' means child and 'Krishna' represents the divine god who embodies love, joy, and mischief. This name honors the playful and nurturing aspects of the divine, reminding us of the joy and wonder of childhood and the grace of the divine in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Bala Krishna was an avatar of Lord Vishnu, who appeared in the form of a young boy to defeat the demon King Narasasura. This incarnation is also known as Balarama and is considered the elder brother of Lord Krishna.

Balakrishna was a popular name for Lord Krishna during the medieval period in India. During this time, the Bhagavata Purana was widely read and recited, and the worship of Lord Krishna in his infant or childhood form became increasingly popular.

On Social Media, there are numerous fan pages and communities dedicated to Balakrishna, showcasing his iconic roles and the devotion towards him.
